stem:
A train left the station at 9:00 and traveled as shown by the distance-time graph.

Which statements BEST describe the motion of the train? Select TWO correct answers.

options.text: The train accelerates until 11:00, and then the speed becomes constant.
The train has a constant speed until 11:00 and then stops moving.
The train’s speed increases, starting at 12:30.
The train travels a total round-trip distance of 60 km.

visual_elements: Distance vs. Time graph showing time from 9:00 to 14:00 on the x-axis and distance (km) from 0 to 70 on the y-axis.
